text:
maria: Hey team, noticed a perf regression + occasional NaNs after landing flashx-paged-fused + KV prefetch for fp8 workloads. p95 latency jumped and a few runs produced softmax overflow warnings.

ron: ugh. which commit/rollout? any repro steps?

maria: rolled yesterday from 2026-03-17T03:12 -> feature/flashx-paged-prefetch (merge PR #4126). Repro on our small Llama-like test: 
```bash
python perf/run_loader.py --model tiny --kernel flashx-paged-fused --quant fp8-e4m3 --kv-prefetch true --batch_size 8 --seq 1024
```
logs show: 
```
[2026-03-17 14:11:02] WARN softmax: detected overflow in fp8 path, clamping logits -> possible NaN in attention output
[2026-03-17 14:11:02] ERROR kv_prefetch: prefetch miss -> invalid cache state for shard 2
```

adele: what are the numbers? how bad is perf hit?

maria: before change p95 ~28ms, after ~37ms on same machine (A100s). throughput down ~12% at steady state. NaNs are rare (~1/5000 tokens) but fail some evals.

lee: interesting that KV prefetch correlates. Could prefetch change access pattern enough to affect numeric range? Were we switching to an fp8-only accumulation for softmax?

maria: yes the flashx route uses fp8 matmul + fp8 reduction in softmax when quant policy==aggressive. The kernel selector picks that for small batch/long seq combos to save memory. Might be a numeric stability tradeoff.

ron: quick guess: prefetch changes ordering so max(logits) maybe larger and with fp8 scaling we underflow/overflow the exp. Need to check where we compute max and exp scale. Also check if KV prefetch merges keys that increase dot-product magnitude.

adele: can you paste the perf profile? flamegraph or p99 stacks?

maria: attaching a short profile snippet (flattened CPU/GPU timeline):
```
flame: flashx_kernel::fused_attn -> 62%
KV_prefetch_runner -> 10%
softmax_fp8_reduction -> 8% (with occasional spike -> NaN sanitize path)
```

perf-bot: New perf alert: job perf/attn_regression/2267894321 failed (p95 +32%). See CI link: https://ci.internal/perf/2267894321

ci-bot: test attn_numerics_fp8 failed 3/10 runs. Artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/perf/2267894321/

lee: action plan: (1) add a numeric guard in kernel selector: disallow fp8 softmax for kv-prefetch=true for now; (2) add a fast path that computes max(logits) in fp32 before exp when quant==fp8; (3) run microbench comparing bf16 vs fp8 for same config.

ron: second the guard. Also add a repro harness that toggles kv-prefetch and quant modes to reproduce NaN deterministically. I'll add a simple loop to stress it.

adele: i'll run the eval suite across recent commits and tag failing rollouts. If guard fixes, we should roll a patch release to canary.

maria: temporary mitigation: set kernel_selector override: 
```bash
export REDWOOD_KERNEL_PREFER=flash-fused,flashx-paged-fused
# disable fp8 aggressive path for prefetch
export REDWOOD_QUANT_POLICY_OVERRIDES='{"kv_prefetch": {"fp8_softmax": false}}'
```
This drops mem savings but stabilizes numerics.

lee: good. could also try dynamic logit scaling: subtract max(logits) computed in fp32 before casting to fp8. Might cost a few cycles but keep fp8 path. Worth prototyping.

maria: notes from quick experiment: when I forced fp32 max reduction the NaNs disappeared on 1000 runs. latency increase negligible (~+1.2ms). Seems promising.

ron: ok PR checklist: 
- add selector guard (lee)
- add fp32-max softmax fallback in flashx kernel (maria + eng-runtime)
- add stress harness that toggles kv prefetch & quant (ron)
- run full eval (adele)

maria: assigning tasks on PR #4132, will push a WIP patch for fp32-max tonight.

lee: ping me when WIP is up, i'll review and benchmark. Also update kernel heuristics doc so selector doesn't pick fp8 softmax for long-seq + kv-prefetch.

adele: tagging this for canary hold until fixes merged. :warning:

maria: thanks all — I'll post updates in this thread. If anyone sees similar NaNs in other models pls drop a note.

perf-bot: Follow-up task created: ENG-ATTN-582 "Investigate fp8 softmax instability with KV prefetch" assigned to maria, lee, ron.
